exposure: Prophylactic intraoperative internal iliac artery balloon occlusion
cohort: 10 women with invasive placenta undergoing scheduled caesarean delivery
finding: The combined use of internal iliac artery balloon occlusion and uterine artery embolization seems to be an effective strategy to control blood loss and preserve the uterus in women with invasive placenta undergoing cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study aimed to assess the efficacy of a specific procedure in preserving the uterus during cesarean delivery for invasive placenta, with a 70% success rate reported.
